title: mcw-2006-heavyweight
label: Bryan Storms

won.source: MCW's own Title History document; the title match itself is served on the fed's own "Zero Hour" pay-per-view page, same date

lost.source: MCW's own Title History document: Storms was stripped of the title after turning on the promotion and defecting to a rival fed (Ultimate Championship Wrestling)

how: Stripped of the title after an on-air defection to a rival federation; not lost in a match.

title: mcw-2006-heavyweight
label: Chandler Maxwell

won.source: MCW's own Title History document: Maxwell outlasted seven others in a battle royal for the vacant title; the build vignettes for the match are served on the fed's own "MCW Heavyweight Title Battle Royal" page

how: Won a battle royal for the vacant title.
note: No further Heavyweight Championship reign is recorded in the held record; the fed's own last dated document (29 May 2007) declares MCW dormant with no title change reported.

won.source: MCW's own Title History document; the tournament final is served on the fed's own "Zero Hour" pay-per-view page, same date

end.source: MCW's own Title History document: the title "is declared retired," with no reason given

title: mcw-2006-legend
label: The Dragon

won.source: MCW's own Title History document: a sixty-minute Ironman match between the two ended in a draw, and both were awarded the title

how: A sixty-minute Ironman match against each other ended in a draw; the fed awarded the belt to both competitors.
note: A one-off award (the fed's own Title History document calls it "a special championship belt presented on a special occasion"), not a standing, defended title; no further reign is recorded.
